subject: general
question: Who was the third ruler ruler of the Mamluk dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iltutmish**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iltutmish succeeded Qutb-ud-din Aibak's son, Aram Shah,** and is considered one of the most significant rulers of the Mamluk Dynasty.
 
• He consolidated the empire, established administrative and military reforms, and strengthened the Sultanate's position in India from **1211 to 1236 AD. **
 
• He established a strong administrative framework, organized the revenue system, and introduced the **Iqta system**, where land grants were given to military officials instead of salary.
 
• Iltutmish is known for his contributions to architecture, including **completing ****the Qutub Minar, **which his predecessor, Qutb-ud-din Aibak, started.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
